summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. Replaced previous single-password auth tests with full multi-role suite covering JWT auth (admin/viewer), self-registration, RBAC on writes, admin user management (ban/unban/delete + admin self-protection), seed idempotency, new fields (gd_number, buyer_city, gross_weight_kg, cartons), per-record currency (EUR Italy embroidery), and Gemini-3-Flash extract. 25/25 pytest cases passed (100%).

minor.issue: country/buyer/exporter regex anchors are case-insensitive but only `product` uses re.escape. Country/buyer/exporter values are escaped now in the new code (line 240-244 use re.escape) - verified OK. Note: q/$or branch in /records and /search does NOT escape user input, so regex metacharacters in search queries (e.g. '(', '[') would 500.
Banned check happens after password verification - a banned user with wrong password still sees 401 (info leak is minor; acceptable).
Idempotent only by count>0; no way to re-seed or upsert. Non-blocking.
No max upload size check; large files could OOM. Non-blocking for MVP.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~570 lines with inline 30-record SAMPLE_RECORDS. Consider moving seed data to a separate module (e.g. seed_data.py) for readability and easier maintenance.
/api/search and /api/records use raw user `q` inside MongoDB $regex without re.escape - a query like 'shirts(' will throw 500. Wrap with re.escape() for the $or branch.
JWT_SECRET defaults to 'change-me' if env missing - good that it's set in .env, but consider raising at startup if env is missing in production.
Stats endpoint loads up to 5000 records and computes aggregates in Python; will not scale beyond ~10k records. Consider mongo aggregation pipeline.
All endpoints correctly exclude _id via projection. Good. Pydantic models with ConfigDict(extra='ignore') protect against payload pollution. Good.
Admin seed-on-startup updates password when env changes - good, idempotent, and matches /app/auth_testing.md guidelines.
test_credentials: Admin: azulmax990@gmail.com / Admin@2026 (verified). Viewers created via /api/auth/register and cleaned up via /api/admin/users/{id} DELETE.
seed_data_creation: DB already had 30 seeded records (per task context). /api/seed returned seeded=false, existing>=25 in both calls. The Italy/Naples embroidery record verified with EUR currency, GD #2, 49kg, 3 cartons, €82/kg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full multi-role auth verified. All test data uses TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up after each test. Viewer test users registered during the run are deleted via admin DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. To run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Note: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is in /app/frontend/.env, not backend env, so export it before running pytest.
rca of the issue: No issues - all 25 tests passed including new RBAC, ban/unban flows, and Italy embroidery EUR record verification.
